text.description_html:
Extra Heavy Duty Door Pivot Set

Set includes Top Pivot, Bottom Pivot and Two (2) Intermediate Pivots. Suitable for doors weighing up to 1000 pounds. These pivots are engineered for durability on extra heavy doors.

Specifications: for ABH-L0147/2xL019-630 Door Pivot Set

  • 3/4" offset pivots
  • UL listed for use on 3 hour fire doors
  • BHMA/ANSI C07162/3530A (modified)
  • Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Handed - specify left hand door or right hand door when ordering

*Important When selecting Door Hand for this pivot hinge:
1. Stand on the Push Side of the door, facing the door.
2. If the "Pivot Hinge" is on your "Left", choose "Left Hand Door".
3. If the "Pivot Hinge" is on your "Right", choose "Right Hand Door".
